negative_snippets: Rooms were dusty and dirty bedsheets ,very bad experience and did not let us out of the hotel when we complained. Disrespectful towards guests especially ladies, no kitchen facilities not even tea and coffee. Would not recommend to anyone.

It was a very, very poor service. The bathroom, toilet, and room were extremely dirty and unhygienic. The closet flush wasn’t working, and even though I complained about it at the reception, nothing was done. They said they would change the room but never did. Since I had already paid in cash and had no other option, I had to stay there — honestly, I felt completely stuck. The room was so bad that I couldn’t even eat food there; it made me feel like vomiting. I have never given a review — good or bad — for any hotel before, but I just can’t stay silent about this one. I’m writing this so that no one else gets trapped like I did.
